item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 19/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring showers and squally thunderstorms to Guangdong in the next couple of days. With the trough of low pressure weakening, showers will ease off over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. A surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week.
